boards.title: Your First Weekend at Ohio State University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented through Ohio State’s central campus landmarks, collections and public spaces.

cards.title: Start at the Ohio Union
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · 1739 N. High Street
cards.notes: Use the building as an early meetup point, then check its posted events and building map before choosing the rest of your campus walk.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a central Student Life building and a clear place to regroup.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio Union is a center for activity, community dialogue and learning and lists building maps, dining locations and Student Life departments.
cards.access_notes: Regular building hours are listed as 8 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Friday and 10 a.m.–11 p.m. Saturday–Sunday; verify special-date hours before going.

cards.title: Take the first cross-campus walk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Central academic campus
cards.notes: Walk the brick paths from Thompson Library toward College Road, pausing to spot the buildings framing Ohio State’s central green space.
cards.short_summary: Make the Oval your first visual reference point for central campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio State identifies the Oval as an 11-acre central open space and its official visit page encourages visitors to stroll across it.
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor campus space; use the university campus map for step-by-step walking directions.

cards.title: Find a study-space fallback
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 1858 Neil Avenue Mall
cards.notes: Take a lap through the library, locate the information desk and note the gallery, computers and group-study options for a future reset.
cards.short_summary: Get familiar with a library that combines research help, study space and exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Thompson Library offers study spaces, more than 230 computers, a gallery and research help for visitors.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 7:30 a.m.–8 p.m. weekdays and 11 a.m.–6 p.m. Saturday and Sunday; check the location page for changes.

cards.title: Wind down at Mirror Lake
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Mirror Lake District
cards.notes: Take the paths around the lake and Browning Amphitheatre, then use the walk back to notice how this quieter district connects to the Oval.
cards.short_summary: A calm outdoor stop that introduces a historic section of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio State’s Mirror Lake District includes historic Mirror Lake and Browning Amphitheater, and the university describes the district as officially open.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor paths are part of the renovated Mirror Lake District; follow posted conditions and event set-ups.

cards.title: Listen for the Orton Hall chimes
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · South side of the Oval
cards.notes: Circle the exterior to see the stonework, then listen for the University Chimes, which provide an easy audible landmark while you learn the campus.
cards.short_summary: Use Ohio State’s distinctive geology building as a south-Oval waypoint.
cards.evidence_claim: Orton Hall sits on the south side of the Oval and contains University Chimes that ring every 15 minutes.
cards.access_notes: The exterior is a campus landmark. The museum gallery is normally open weekdays during the academic year; do not plan a weekend interior visit without confirming.

cards.title: Save a free museum visit
cards.subtitle: Weekday add-on · Orton Hall
cards.notes: Download the museum’s self-guided highlights before a future weekday visit, and use it to focus your time on the fossils and geological displays.
cards.short_summary: A free museum stop to schedule when its public gallery is open.
cards.evidence_claim: The Orton Geological Museum states that admission is open to all people and free, and provides a self-guided-tour resource.
cards.access_notes: During the academic year, the gallery is normally open 10 a.m.–4 p.m. on weekdays and is not open weekends; summer weekday hours are irregular.

cards.title: See the ’Shoe up close
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · West campus edge
cards.notes: Approach the stadium from the campus side and use its horseshoe form as a navigational landmark before continuing toward the recreation area.
cards.short_summary: Add a recognizable campus landmark to your first walking loop.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio State’s official visitor guidance specifically includes seeing Ohio Stadium, known as the ’Shoe, up close on a campus tour.
cards.access_notes: View the exterior and check official athletics or university notices before expecting entry or event access.

cards.title: Browse the cartoon museum galleries
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Sullivant Hall, 1813 N. High Street
cards.notes: Walk in during gallery hours, browse the current exhibition, and leave time to explore the surrounding High Street campus edge afterward.
cards.short_summary: A public, free museum-gallery stop with rotating cartoon-art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Billy Ireland Cartoon Library & Museum says its exhibition galleries are open to the public, admission is free and walk-in visitors are welcome.
cards.source_title: Location and Hours | Billy Ireland Cartoon Library & Museum
cards.access_notes: Museum galleries list 1–5 p.m. Tuesday–Sunday and are closed Monday; consult the official closure list before a visit.

cards.title: Look for Buckeye Grove
cards.subtitle: Saturday sunset · Main campus
cards.notes: Use the university’s campus map to locate the grove, then make it a short outdoor photo and orientation stop rather than a destination that needs a schedule.
cards.short_summary: A named campus landscape with an official Ohio State photo resource.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio State’s communications office publishes an official campus image titled “Buckeye Grove in Fall.”
cards.access_notes: Locate the named place using Ohio State’s campus map and observe any temporary access controls.

cards.title: Choose one public-art detour
cards.subtitle: Sunday daytime · Columbus campus
cards.notes: Open the official art map, select one artwork near your route and make a short walking detour; keep the stop flexible around weather and building access.
cards.short_summary: Turn the trip between familiar landmarks into a self-guided art walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Arts at Ohio State maintains a public-art map with works across West, North, Central and South Campus and the Wexner Medical Center.
cards.source_title: Public Art | Arts at Ohio State
cards.access_notes: The map includes indoor and outdoor works; confirm a selected work’s location and building access before heading over.
